root_cause_analysis.observed_issue: Mac curl to /symbols/EURUSD/tick returned bid=0, ask=0 and failure_bucket=symbol_not_selected. User screenshot shows EURUSD visible in Market Watch on Windows.

possible_causes.description: Broker uses suffixed symbol (e.g. EURUSDm, EURUSD.a) while API was queried with exact 'EURUSD'. symbol_info('EURUSD') returns None, resulting in symbol_not_found. The route fallback then may surface symbol_not_selected when failure_bucket is generic.
possible_causes.evidence: mt5_client symbol_info_tick_with_auto_select returns symbol_not_found when symbol_info(symbol) is None. Route uses failure_bucket or 'symbol_not_selected' as fallback when tick is None.

possible_causes.description: Sidecar connected to different MT5 terminal path than the one operator sees. Market Watch state differs.
possible_causes.evidence: Verify MT5_TERMINAL_PATH in sidecar .env matches the running terminal. Run fxg_win_probe_mt5_identity.ps1 to capture terminal_path.

possible_causes.description: Symbol visible in UI but not selected in the API instance (MT5 Python symbol_select state). symbol_info_tick returns None until symbol_select(symbol, True) is called.
possible_causes.evidence: mt5_client already calls symbol_select when info.select is False. If info exists but selected=True and tick still None, falls through to no_tick_data.

possible_causes.description: Market closed, symbol inactive, or tick stream not yet available. Tick returned with bid=0, ask=0.
possible_causes.evidence: mt5_client returns no_tick_data when tick exists but bid and ask are both zero.

tick_route_code_path.flow: symbol_info_tick_with_auto_select(symbol) -> mt5.symbol_info_tick(symbol); if None/zero, symbol_info(symbol); if not info -> symbol_not_found; if not selected -> symbol_select(symbol, True), retry tick; if no tick -> no_tick_data; if tick.bid/ask zero -> no_tick_data
tick_route_code_path.route_fallback: When (not tick or failure_bucket), route returns failure_bucket or 'symbol_not_selected'. So symbol_not_selected appears when failure_bucket was None - which is a code path that should not occur in current mt5_client. Likely historical or user saw recommended_fix text 'Ensure symbol is visible in Market Watch' which implies symbol_not_selected.

recommended_fix: Add symbol_name_mismatch detection: when symbol_info(symbol) is None, search symbols_get() for {symbol}*-like names; if found, return symbol_name_mismatch with broker_symbol_actual. Add /symbols/probe endpoint for operator to discover actual broker symbol. Surface broker_symbol_actual in TickResponse when mismatch.
